events.title: Next Fest Demo Update!

events.title: Cash is King! Playtest
events.summary: We’re excited to introduce our latest game: Cash is King!Sun, sand and money are in the air. You start with empty pockets and work your way up in this chill first-person simulation. Collect cash, improve your reputation and enjoy fun, slightly chaotic gameplay with hustles and funny minigames. In the end, only one thing counts: Cash is King – and you want the crown.The Steam page for Cash is King is now live, and the public playtest kicks off today!
